text: Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy describes how Xult collects, uses, discloses, and protects information in connection with the Services. Please read it together with our [Terms of Use](https://xult.ltd/terms/).
Effective date: September 5, 2026 · Last updated: November 4, 2026

Xult Pty Ltd (ACN 668 030 591) (“**Xult**,” “**we**,” “**us**,” or “**our**”), an Australian proprietary company registered in Western Australia, operates [xult.ltd](https://xult.ltd/) and [xult.com](https://xult.com/), publishes **Rosary Guide** at [rosaryguide.app](https://rosaryguide.app/), and is the developer of the Rosary Guide application distributed through the Apple App Store (together with related pages and support channels, the “**Services**”).

This Privacy Policy applies to Personal Data we process as a controller when you visit our websites, use Rosary Guide, contact us, or otherwise interact with the Services. It does not govern Apple, Formsubmit, Google (including Firebase), hosting providers, or other independent third parties, each of which processes information under its own terms and policies.

We do **not** sell Personal Data. We do not share Personal Data for cross-context behavioral advertising. We do not use prayer activity to build advertising profiles. We do not use generative artificial intelligence or large language models (LLMs) to Process Personal Data in Rosary Guide. We do not require an account to pray with the current web experience, or to use Rosary Guide on iOS. You can continue as a guest; guest data stays on the device.
Questions and privacy requests: use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/).
1. Definitions

“**Personal Data**” means information that identifies, relates to, describes, or could reasonably be linked with an individual, and includes “personal information” and “personally identifiable information” under applicable law.
“**Process**” means any operation performed on Personal Data, including collection, storage, use, disclosure, and deletion.
“**Service Providers**” (also called processors) are parties that Process Personal Data on our behalf under instructions, solely to provide services to us.
2. Categories of Personal Data we collect
The categories below describe Personal Data we collect and have collected in the preceding twelve (12) months, the purposes, typical examples, and the categories of recipients.
Identifiers and contact data

**Examples:** name, email address, and the contents of a support or contact message, if you write to us or use the contact form. **Purpose:** to respond, keep a record of the correspondence, and handle privacy or legal requests. **Recipients:** Service Providers that host email or process forms (including Formsubmit, which receives submissions from the contact form); Xult personnel who handle the request.
Internet, device, and technical data

**Examples:** IP address, browser or operating-system type, device type, language, referring URL, requested pages, and timestamps. **Purpose:** to operate, secure, and diagnose the Services, prevent abuse, and keep hosting available. **Recipients:** hosting and content-delivery Service Providers. Our sites load fonts from Google Fonts; Google may receive your IP address and related technical data when those fonts are requested, under Google’s policies.
Device preferences stored locally

**Examples:** a light- or dark-theme preference stored in your browser’s local storage on xult.ltd and xult.com. **Purpose:** to remember your display preference. **Recipients:** none. This value remains on your device and is not used to identify you across sites.
On-device application state

**Examples:** prayer progress, intentions, preferences, and similar state that Rosary Guide keeps on your device, including everything you save when you continue as a guest. **Purpose:** to provide the guide without an account. **Recipients:** none. Guest data stays on the device and is not sent to Firebase. Some device-only state, such as whether you have already seen the welcome, stays on the device even if you later sign in.
Rosary Guide iOS account and sync data

**Examples:** if you sign in to Rosary Guide on iOS with Sign in with Apple or Sign in with Google, authentication identifiers from that provider through Firebase Authentication (a user identifier and, if the provider shares them, a name or email address); prayer intentions stored in Cloud Firestore (including title, note, category, and related fields such as pin state and timestamps); prayer progress and history (prayed days and an in-progress rosary, which may include the titles of intentions offered with that rosary); and synced preferences such as appearance (color theme), prayer language, text size, the Saint Michael toggle, the hide-intention toggle, reminder settings, and app icon. **Purpose:** app functionality and cross-device sync. **Recipients:** Firebase (Google), for Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and Firebase App Check, acting as a Service Provider (processor); and Apple or Google as the identity provider when you sign in with that provider.
Inferences, advertising, and precise location
We do not collect precise geolocation. We do not create advertising profiles. We do not sell or share Personal Data with data brokers or advertising networks.
Sensitive Personal Data

We do not require you to provide religious affiliation, health information, or other sensitive Personal Data as a condition of using Rosary Guide. If you include religious, spiritual, or other sensitive details in a message to us, we Process that content only to handle your request. If you include such details in a prayer intention or note that you sync, we Process that content only to provide the guide and to sync it to your account. We do not collect or Process sensitive Personal Data for the purpose of inferring characteristics about you, and we do not use or disclose sensitive Personal Data except for purposes permitted under applicable law (including California Civil Code regulations section 7027(m), where applicable).
3. Sources
We collect Personal Data:
• directly from you, when you submit the contact form or otherwise communicate with us, and, if you sign in to Rosary Guide, when you save intentions, prayer progress, or preferences;
• automatically from your device and browser when you use the Services (and from Service Providers that operate our infrastructure); and

• from Apple, if you download or use the iOS application through the App Store, and from Apple or Google when you choose Sign in with Apple or Sign in with Google (received through Firebase Authentication).
4. How we use Personal Data
We use Personal Data to:
• provide, operate, maintain, and secure the Services, and sync a signed-in Rosary Guide account across devices;
• respond to support, privacy, press, and other inquiries;
• detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents;
• comply with law, enforce our Terms of Use, and protect the rights, property, and safety of Xult, users, and others; and
• establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

If we intend to Process Personal Data for a new purpose that is materially different, unrelated, or incompatible with the purposes described here, we will provide notice as described in Section 14 and, where required, obtain consent.

We do not engage in automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects concerning you. We do not use generative artificial intelligence or large language models (LLMs) to Process Personal Data in Rosary Guide.
5. Legal bases (EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland)
Where the GDPR, UK GDPR, or Swiss law applies, we Process Personal Data on the following bases:
• **Contract.** To provide the Services you request, including sync of a signed-in Rosary Guide account, and to respond to support you initiate (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

• **Legitimate interests.** To operate and secure the Services, prevent abuse, improve reliability, and communicate about requests you have made, where those interests are not overridden by your rights (Art. 6(1)(f)).
• **Legal obligation.** To comply with applicable law, including responding to lawful requests (Art. 6(1)(c)).

• **Consent.** Where we ask for it, or where you voluntarily send us information that we would not otherwise collect (Art. 6(1)(a)). You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of Processing before withdrawal.

If a message you send includes special-category data (for example, information about religious belief), we Process it only as needed to handle your request, typically on the basis of your explicit consent by sending the communication, or as otherwise permitted by Art. 9 GDPR. If a prayer intention you choose to sync includes such data, we Process it only as needed to provide and sync the guide, and not to infer characteristics about you.
6. Disclosure
We disclose Personal Data only as follows:

• **Service Providers.** Hosting, content delivery, email, and form-processing providers, including Formsubmit for the website contact form, and **Firebase (Google)** for Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and Firebase App Check, which authenticate signed-in Rosary Guide users and store and sync their account data. They may Process Personal Data only to perform services for us. Rosary Guide does not use Firebase Storage, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, or advertising or tracking SDKs.
• **Apple.** When you download or use the iOS application through the App Store, and as the identity provider when you choose Sign in with Apple.
• **Google.** As the identity provider when you choose Sign in with Google, and as the operator of Firebase (Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and App Check) and of Google Fonts on our websites.

• **Professional advisers and authorities.** Counsel, auditors, or public authorities where we are legally required to disclose information, or where disclosure is necessary to protect against serious harm, fraud, or abuse.

• **Business transfers.** If we sell, merge, reorganize, or transfer all or part of our business, Personal Data may transfer to the successor as part of that transaction, subject to this Policy or a successor policy providing equivalent protection. We will use reasonable efforts to provide notice before your information becomes subject to a materially different policy.

We may create aggregated, de-identified, or anonymized data that cannot reasonably identify you, and we may use and disclose that data for lawful purposes, including analysis and improvement of the Services.
7. Retention

We retain Personal Data only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including to complete a support conversation, comply with legal or security obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

As a general practice: support emails and form submissions are retained for the duration of the matter and typically up to two (2) years thereafter, unless a longer period is required by law or needed to address a security or legal issue; server logs are retained on our host’s ordinary rotation schedule; website local-storage preferences remain until you clear site data; guest and other on-device Rosary Guide data remain on your device until you delete the application or clear that data; and synced Rosary Guide account data in Firebase is kept while the account exists, unless we must delete it sooner.

If you are signed in, you can delete your account in Settings. **Delete account** asks you to confirm with Sign in with Apple or Sign in with Google first. It then permanently deletes your Rosary Guide account and everything synced to it (intentions, prayer history and settings), then clears your prayer data from this device. We delete the synced Cloud Firestore data (intentions, preferences, and prayer progress) and then the Firebase Authentication account, and we revoke the Apple or Google sign-in as implemented for that provider. This cannot be undone. You may also ask us to delete Personal Data through the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/).
When retention ends, we delete or de-identify Personal Data, except where we must keep a limited record to comply with law.
8. Security

We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures appropriate to the nature of the Personal Data we Process, including transmission over HTTPS and access limited to personnel and Service Providers who need it. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. You use the Services at your own risk. If we become aware of a breach affecting your Personal Data, we will notify you and regulators as required by applicable law. If you believe your information has been compromised, use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/).
9. Children

Rosary Guide may be used by families for personal devotion. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children under thirteen (13) years of age in the United States (or under sixteen (16) in the European Economic Area or United Kingdom, or the age of digital consent in the child’s country) for marketing, profiling, or account creation. The current web experience does not require an Xult account. On iOS you can continue as a guest without an account; guest data stays on the device.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has provided Personal Data to us, use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/). We will delete the information, except where we must retain a limited record to comply with law. We do not sell or share the Personal Data of consumers we know to be under sixteen (16).
10. Your privacy rights
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
• know, access, and receive a copy of Personal Data we hold about you;
• correct inaccurate Personal Data;
• delete Personal Data, subject to legal exceptions;
• export Personal Data in a portable format;
• opt out of sale or sharing of Personal Data (we do not sell or share);
• limit use and disclosure of sensitive Personal Data (we do not use it to infer characteristics);
• object to or restrict certain Processing;
• withdraw consent where Processing is based on consent;
• appeal a denial of a request; and
• lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (for example, your EU or UK data-protection authority).

To exercise these rights, use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/) and include an address we can reasonably associate with the request. Signed-in Rosary Guide users may also delete their account and the data synced to it in Settings, as described in Section 7. We may need additional information to verify your identity. You may use an authorized agent where the law permits; we may require proof of authorization and identity. We will not discriminate against you for exercising these rights.

We will respond within the time required by applicable law (generally forty-five (45) days under California law, extendable as permitted, and one (1) month under the GDPR, extendable as permitted). If we deny a request, we will explain the reasons and how to appeal, where an appeal right applies.
California and other U.S. state privacy laws

Residents of California and of other U.S. states with comprehensive privacy laws (including, as applicable, Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Montana, Delaware, Iowa, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Tennessee, Minnesota, Maryland, and similar enactments) have the rights described above to the extent provided by those laws.

In the preceding twelve (12) months we have not sold Personal Data and have not shared Personal Data for cross-context behavioral advertising. We have no actual knowledge of selling or sharing Personal Data of consumers under sixteen (16). We do not use or disclose sensitive Personal Data for purposes other than those permitted by law for providing the Services, security, and short-term transient use.

California residents may also request information about our disclosure of Personal Data to third parties for those parties’ direct marketing, under California’s “Shine the Light” law. We do not make such disclosures. Requests may be sent through the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/).
11. International transfers

Xult Pty Ltd (ACN 668 030 591) is an Australian company registered in Western Australia. If you use the Services from another country, your Personal Data may be Processed in Australia, in the United States, and in other countries where our Service Providers operate, including where Google processes Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and App Check. Those countries may not provide the same level of data protection as your home country.

Where required, we rely on transfer mechanisms recognized under applicable law, which may include Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, the UK International Data Transfer Addendum, an adequacy decision, or another lawful mechanism.
12. Cookies, local storage, and signals

The Xult website uses local storage to remember your theme preference. We do not currently use advertising cookies or cross-site tracking pixels on xult.ltd or xult.com. Third parties we load for functionality (including Google Fonts) may set or read their own cookies or receive technical data as described in their policies.

Our sites do not currently respond to browser Do Not Track signals. Where a legally recognized opt-out preference signal such as the Global Privacy Control is required to be honored as a request to opt out of sale or sharing, we will treat it as such. Because we do not sell or share Personal Data for cross-context advertising, no additional action is required for that purpose.
13. Third-party sites and services

The Services may link to third-party sites, including rosaryguide.app (when operated as a separate origin), Apple’s App Store, and other resources. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those third parties. Review their policies before providing them information.
14. Changes

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date will change when we do. If we make a material change, we will provide additional notice as appropriate, such as a notice on the website or in the application. Your continued use of the Services after the effective date of a revised Policy constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy, except where applicable law requires a different method of consent. If you do not agree, discontinue use of the Services and use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/) to exercise applicable deletion rights.
15. Contact
The data controller is Xult. [Support](https://xult.ltd/contact/)

If you are in the EEA, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, you may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. We invite you to use the [Contact form](https://xult.ltd/contact/) first so that we may attempt to resolve the matter.
